Could not confirm the ERCOT 8-12 month (small) and 18-30 month (large) durations in the thresholds argument. The Aug 1 2026 Planning Guide Section 5 confirms the 10 MW split but states no such durations. Other ERCOT sources (for example a stakeholder slide) were not checked.

Web leads 1-9 in skip/web-leads.md are news, vendor, deal, politics and applications items outside this lane; not written here. Lead 7 (Fortune, military/NASA power) was searched; the article itself was not found and no event was identified.

checks.claim: ERCOT is the sharpest: a unit at 9.9 MW runs the Small Generation process at a stated 8-12 months; the identical unit at 10.1 MW runs Large Generation at 18-30 months. Ten to twenty-two months of schedule decided by 0.2 MW.
checks.evidence: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 5 (Generator Interconnection or Modification), dated August 1, 2026, confirms the size split: a generator is a large generator at 10 MW or greater and a small generator below 10 MW, so a 9.9 MW unit is small and a 10.1 MW unit is large. The section does not state the 8-12 month (small) or 18-30 month (large) study durations, so those figures are not supported by this document. The durations may come from another ERCOT source that was not checked.
